title: 323 Area Code: Location, Cities Served & Lookup Info
meta_description: Looking up 323 Area Code? Discover its central Los Angeles coverage, Pacific Time rules, and 213 overlay details. Check calling facts and local maps.

faqs.question: What city is area code 323 located in?
faqs.answer: Area code 323 is located in California, primary serving central Los Angeles, Hollywood, West Hollywood, Silver Lake, Echo Park, and surrounding central communities.

faqs.question: Are 323 and 213 area codes the same?
faqs.answer: Yes. Area codes 323 and 213 serve the exact same geographic region in central Los Angeles as part of an administrative overlay system.

faqs.question: Do I need to dial 1 for local calls in the 323 area code?
faqs.answer: No. You only need to dial the 10-digit number (323 + 7-digit number) for local calls. Adding a "1" is reserved for long-distance dialing.

faqs.question: What time zone is the 323 area code in?
faqs.answer: The 323 area code operates in the Pacific Time Zone (PT), observing Pacific Standard Time (PST) in winter and Pacific Daylight Time (PDT) in summer.

faqs.question: Can I get a virtual 323 number for my remote business?
faqs.answer: Yes. Most major business VoIP and cloud phone providers offer 323 virtual numbers that can be managed from anywhere globally via internet desktop or mobile apps.

323 Area Code: The Ultimate Geographic & Telecommunications Guide

The 323 area code serves as one of the primary telecommunications identifiers for the vibrant city of Los Angeles, California. Covering central neighborhoods, cultural hubs, and historic districts, understanding how the 323 area code operates is important for residents, local business owners, and telecommunications professionals alike.

What is the 323 Area Code?

The 323 area code is a North American Numbering Plan (NANP) telephone area code serving central Los Angeles, California, including neighborhoods like Hollywood, Silver Lake, and Downtown LA. Overlayed with the 213 area code, it requires 10-digit dialing for all local calls within its coverage region.

Geographic Reach and Coverage Areas

Originally carved out of the historic 213 area code in 1998, the 323 area code spans a dense urban territory in Southern California. Unlike sprawling suburban area codes, 323 covers a concentrated metropolitan footprint that includes classic Los Angeles neighborhoods and adjacent cities.

Key Neighborhoods and Municipalities Served

  • Central Los Angeles: Hollywood, East Hollywood, Silver Lake, Echo Park, and Los Feliz.
  • South & East Los Angeles: South Gate, Huntington Park, Florence-Graham, and Boyle Heights.
  • Adjacent Cities: West Hollywood, Bell, Bell Gardens, and portions of Commerce and Pasadena.

Because the region experiences high population density and heavy demand for mobile numbers, the California Public Utilities Commission (CPUC) approved an overlay in 2017. Today, the 323 area code shares its exact geographic boundary with the 213 area code, allowing new telecommunication lines in central LA to be assigned either prefix.

The Evolution of Metropolitan Numbering Plans

The management of telephone area codes across North America relies on strict geographic partitioning and administrative overlays. As smartphone adoption, connected IoT devices, and virtual business lines expand, local telephone authorities must frequently update regional numbering plans.

For context, urban centers across the United States face similar telecommunication capacity management challenges:

  • Pacific Northwest: Washington state's major tech hub relies on the 206 area code for central Seattle, operating alongside surrounding regional codes.
  • California Overlays: In Orange County, the 657 area code operates as an overlay for the older 714 region, mirroring the 323/213 setup in Los Angeles.
  • East Coast Hubs: Central Maryland utilizes the 443 area code as an overlay for the 410 region, while Long Island in New York depends heavily on the 631 area code for its residential and commercial lines.
  • Southern & Sunbelt Regions: Central Florida relies on the 941 area code, coastal Texas utilizes the 979 area code, and Alabama recently introduced the 659 area code to relieve capacity pressures on the older 205 network.
  • Offshore Territories: Puerto Rico utilizes the 939 area code as an overlay alongside the traditional 787 region.

Dialing Rules and How to Make Calls in the 323 Area Code

Because the 323 area code functions as part of a dual-code overlay system, standard dialing procedures require mandatory ten-digit dialing for all local calls. Understanding these basic rules ensures seamless connectivity:

1. Local Calls (Within 323 / 213 Area)

Dial the full 10-digit telephone number (Area Code + 7-digit Phone Number). You do not need to prefix the call with a "1" for local connections, and local call rates apply regardless of whether you dial a 323 or 213 number.

2. Domestic Long-Distance Calls

To call a number outside the local 323/213 zone (such as calling a number in Seattle's 206 area code or Maryland's 443 area code), dial 1 + Area Code + 7-digit Phone Number.

3. International Calls to the 323 Area Code

Callers dialing into central Los Angeles from outside the United States must use their country's international access code, followed by the US country code (+1), and then the 10-digit number (e.g., +1-323-XXX-XXXX).

Business Strategy: The Value of a 323 Business Number

For companies targeting the Los Angeles market, acquiring a 323 area code phone number offers distinct commercial advantages. Local presence plays a critical role in consumer trust and response rates.

Market research consistently demonstrates that consumers are significantly more likely to answer calls from familiar local area codes compared to toll-free numbers or unfamiliar out-of-state prefixes.

Key advantages of operating with a local 323 phone number include:

  • Instant Local Authority: Establishes immediate local credibility in Hollywood, West Hollywood, and central Los Angeles commercial zones.
  • Improved Customer Engagement: Enhances answer rates for local sales teams, delivery services, and client outreach campaigns.
  • Virtual System Integration: Modern Voice over IP (VoIP) platforms allow international businesses to route 323 numbers directly to remote teams anywhere in the world.

Frequently Asked Questions

What city is area code 323 located in?

Area code 323 is located in California, primary serving central Los Angeles, Hollywood, West Hollywood, Silver Lake, Echo Park, and surrounding central communities.

Are 323 and 213 area codes the same?

Yes. Area codes 323 and 213 serve the exact same geographic region in central Los Angeles as part of an administrative overlay system.

Do I need to dial 1 for local calls in the 323 area code?

No. You only need to dial the 10-digit number (323 + 7-digit number) for local calls. Adding a "1" is reserved for long-distance dialing.

What time zone is the 323 area code in?

The 323 area code operates in the Pacific Time Zone (PT), observing Pacific Standard Time (PST) in winter and Pacific Daylight Time (PDT) in summer.

Can I get a virtual 323 number for my remote business?

Yes. Most major business VoIP and cloud phone providers offer 323 virtual numbers that can be managed from anywhere globally via internet desktop or mobile apps.
